Below is a description of what’s happening and a minimal patch to give the “×” icon the non‐empty accessible name it needs so that the “WAI-ARIA widget with IMG role must have a nonempty alternate text or a label” error goes away.

1) Bug scenario & root‐cause  
   - When you render a MultiSelect with `initialSelectedItems`, you see the “2 ×” pill in the closed box.  
   - That “×” is rendered by the `<Close16 />` SVG, which by default comes out as `<svg role="img" aria-hidden="true">…</svg>`.  DAP complains “IMG role missing non‐empty title attribute.”  
   - We need to pass in a label (or title) prop onto the icon so that it renders a `<title>` or `aria-label`, satisfying the requirement.

2) Patch  
   - We only need to edit the ListBoxSelection component.  
   - Change the lone `<Close16 />` into `<Close16 aria-label={description} aria-hidden={false} />` so that the icon no longer has an empty label.  

```javascript
### packages/react/src/components/ListBox/ListBoxSelection.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
      {selectionCount}
      <Close16 />
=======
      {selectionCount}
      <Close16 aria-label={description} aria-hidden={false} />
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

With this one‐line change the clear‐button’s “×” icon will have a non-empty accessible name (the same text you’re already using for the wrapper’s `title`), and the DAP error about “WAI-ARIA widget with IMG role must have a nonempty alternate text or a label” will disappear.
